messages:
maria: Quick ask  need social plan for next webinar (Serving Inference Economics). Outputs: X announcement + reminder, LinkedIn post, hero image, 15s clip, UTMs, and SDR routing. Lock by EOD tomorrow?
linda: I can own X + LinkedIn. Plan: announce (A/B two openers), reminder, and a pinned reply with a stat pull.
josh: Two opener options: A) 'Cut inference cost 3x with ops, not new models.' B) 'Keep latency, halve the cost: our playbook.' LinkedIn draft ready  will paste shortly.
priya: UTM plan: utm_source={x|linkedin}, utm_medium=social, utm_campaign=serving_econ_jul, utm_term={stat|benefit}, utm_variant={startup|enterprise}. I'll create landing variants so we can route flows.
sam (SDR): HubSpot list = webinar_serving_econ_jul. Routing: round-robin to SDR - Growth. Spike rule: title contains VP|Director -> tag high-intent and notify kevin. Templates: auto-confirm + 20m high-intent ask, no-show nurture.
leo: I can deliver hero (1200x627) + 15s clip if I get final copy and a one-line script by noon.
maria: Script: 'Serving LLMs: cut cost without trading latency. Live Jul 21. Register now.' Design deadline noon, copy final by 10am, priya UTMs by 11am, sam templates by noon.
buffer-bot: Drafts created in Buffer for Jul 19 09:00 (announce) and Jul 21 08:00 (reminder). Pending approval.
kevin: Suggest A/B target: A -> startups/infra, B -> enterprise/platform. We'll boost B on LinkedIn. Priya, can you add paid utm_paid=1 for the paid variant?
priya: Yep. Also adding hidden form fields for utm_campaign and variant. Zap to create HubSpot contact + add to list + Slack notify #sales-inbound.
linda: I'll prepare two thumbnails (stat-first, people-first) and run initial A/B for CTR. Will post results in 48h.
maria: Thanks team  ping here when each item is done and i'll approve Buffer drafts.
